lesson_questions.question: Which Egyptian god was known as the King of the Gods and was even more powerful when combined with Ra?
options: Hathor - Goddess of love and joy
expected_points: Amun was worshipped for his power, especially when combined with Ra.
lesson_questions.source_quote: When Amun was combined with Ra he was even more powerful.

lesson_questions.question: Which goddess was associated with protection and household entertainment, depicted with the head of a cat?
options: Bastet - Protection and the household entertainment
lesson_questions.correct_answer: Bastet - Protection and the household entertainment
expected_points: Bastet was associated with protection and household entertainment.
lesson_questions.source_quote: Bastet Protection and the household entertainment. Daughter of Ra.

lesson_questions.question: Which god was believed to cause earthquakes with his laughter and was symbolized with the head of a goose?
options: Sekmet - Goddess of war and battle
Hathor - Goddess of love and joy
expected_points: Geb was believed to cause earthquakes with his laughter.
lesson_questions.source_quote: Geb The earth God. Egyptians believed earthquakes were his laughter.
